seo.titulo: I'm Afraid There's a Delay — dar má notícia em inglês — Aula 10 GPS Tronic
seo.descricao: Avise o cliente sobre um atraso em inglês sem perder a confiança dele: I'm afraid, Unfortunately, pedir desculpa e propor data nova. Aula 10 do curso GPS Tronic da Capy English, com diálogo em áudio.

hero.sub: A peça não chegou e o cliente está no meio da colheita. Dar a má notícia antes que ele pergunte — em inglês, sem gaguejar e sem perder o cliente.

dialogo.sub: 📞 A peça não chegou. Você liga para o Marcos no meio da colheita dele para avisar antes que ele pergunte — se desculpa, explica o motivo e propõe uma data nova.

I'm afraid I have some bad news.
I want to find the best solution for you.

Unfortunately, express shipping is not available.
We are one day behind schedule.
There is no extra charge for the weekend visit.
I can't come on Friday. I can come on Saturday instead.
Can we reschedule the visit for Saturday?

expressoes.usage: a âncora que prepara o cliente ANTES do fato — dá a ele um segundo para se ajustar
expressoes.example: I'm afraid I have some bad news about your part.

expressoes.usage: a má notícia no meio da conversa, sempre com vírgula depois
expressoes.example: Unfortunately, express shipping is not available this week.

expressoes.expr: I'm really sorry about the delay.
expressoes.usage: pedir desculpa pelo PROBLEMA, sem se defender nem culpar terceiros
expressoes.example: I understand, and I'm really sorry about the delay.

expressoes.usage: a estrutura que salva a ligação: nunca deixe o "não" sozinho no ar
expressoes.example: I can't change the shipping time, but I can visit you on Saturday.

expressoes.usage: devolver o controle ao cliente — ele para de precisar cobrar você
expressoes.example: It will arrive on Friday. I promise I'll call you as soon as it's here.

expressoes.usage: fechar a ligação reconhecendo o incômodo, em vez de fingir que não houve
expressoes.example: Thank you for your patience, Marcos.

gramatica.titulo: Patterns: dar má notícia sem perder o cliente

personagens.YARA: a Brazilian woman technician (thirties, brown skin, shoulder-length curly black hair, dark navy work shirt and pants)
personagens.MARCOS: a Brazilian farmer (forties, brown skin, short black hair and a thick black mustache, dark teal cap, dark teal button-up work shirt and jeans)

gramatica.cenaAbertura: A wide split-screen scene. On the left half, {YARA} stands in a small GPS repair workshop with tools on the wall, holding a phone to her ear. On the right half, {MARCOS} stands in a wide golden soybean field at harvest time, answering his phone, with a combine harvester working behind him.

slides.cena: Close view of a cluttered workbench in a small GPS repair workshop: {YARA} holds a phone to her ear with a careful, apologetic expression, one hand resting on an empty cardboard shipping box with its flaps open, next to an opened GPS display and a screwdriver.

frases.en: **I'm afraid** I have some bad news.
frases.pt: Lamento, mas tenho uma má notícia.

frases.en: **I'm afraid** the part didn't arrive today.
frases.pt: Lamento, mas a peça não chegou hoje.

slides.cena: Low angle view: {MARCOS} sits on the step of his idle green tractor at the edge of a golden soybean field, phone to his ear, frowning, one hand rubbing his forehead, while a combine harvester works far behind him.

frases.en: I'm **sorry about** the wrong tracking number.

slides.cena: In a small GPS repair workshop, {YARA} holds a phone to her ear and smiles with a new idea as she points at a wall calendar made of blank squares, with a cross over one square and a green circle around a later one.

quiz.q: Como abrir uma má notícia ao telefone?
opts: I'm afraid I have some bad news.
I'm afraid of some bad news.
I have afraid some bad news.
I'm afraid that have bad news.
quiz.a: I'm afraid I have some bad news.
quiz.rule: I'm afraid + frase inteira. Não é medo — é o aviso educado.
Unfortunately abre a frase e leva vírgula. E supplier é singular: is.

opts: I'm really sorry about the delay.
I'm really sorry for the delay is late.
quiz.a: I'm really sorry about the delay.
quiz.rule: sorry about + substantivo, com o artigo the.

quiz.q: Qual frase NÃO deixa o cliente só com o problema?
opts: I can't change the date, but I can visit you on Saturday.
Unfortunately I can't change the date.
I'm afraid I can't change the date.
quiz.a: I can't change the date, but I can visit you on Saturday.
quiz.rule: Depois do "não" vem sempre o que você PODE fazer.

opts: It will to arrive on Friday.
quiz.rule: will + verbo base, e dia da semana usa on.

quiz.q: Qual palavra significa "atrasado em relação ao prazo"?

opts: There is no extra charge for the visit.
There is not extra charge for the visit.
There has no extra charge for the visit.
It has no extra charge for the visit.
quiz.a: There is no extra charge for the visit.
quiz.rule: There is no + substantivo. "Tem" de existência nunca é have.
thank you FOR + substantivo. Patience é o substantivo; patient é o adjetivo.
